verification: Actually fetched institutional HTML; leads only, not fact or publication approval. Scope-sensitive review remains mandatory.

entries.scope: Common dry edible bean classes; kidney and white/navy are not interchangeable cultivars. US trial observations only, never an Iranian yield promise. Keep market class, region, harvest moisture and units explicit.
Alfalfa dry matter by cutting; fresh mass cannot be inferred without measured dry matter. Distinguish US short tons, metric tonnes, seasonal totals and per-cut production.
Pumpkin fruit marketable versus total yield; not seed yield or identical to zucchini. US cultivar/site observations only.
Immature summer squash/zucchini fresh market yield, not winter pumpkin fruit or extracted seeds. Preserve per-plant versus per-area denominators.
Qualitative selection criteria for Sesame/Sesamum indicum; do not recommend US cultivars for Iran or transfer US contract availability.
Chickpea/Cicer arietinum, desi vs kabuli criteria; not pea or cowpea. Local adaptation and seed contracts must not be inferred for Iran.
Pisum sativum fresh green peas only if sources actually establish green product; dry field pea and southern pea/cowpea yields MUST be rejected for a fresh-green title.
Vicia sativa common vetch only; generic Persian vetch may be ambiguous. Separate forage dry matter, fresh biomass and harvested seed. Never transfer one product to another.
Tomato plant spacing and deterministic nursery need calculations. Require row spacing, in-row spacing and paths/bed definition; never invent mortality percentages.
Seed pumpkin maturity and spacing; distinguish edible seed harvest from Halloween flesh/color. Generic pumpkin fruit maturity cannot prove edible seed maturity or cultivar-specific planting density.
Lentil/Lens culinaris maturity, shattering and seed quality; no US seasonal calendar, pesticide/desiccant rates or numeric moisture prescription for Iran.
Mungbean/Vigna radiata pod maturity, not black gram or cowpea; distinguish uneven pods, shattering and market quality. No US calendar transferred.

Edible-seed watermelon cultivar-type criteria only, not dessert fruit or Cucumeropsis mannii. Iranian named seed cultivars and equivalence to African egusi cannot be assumed. Genetic papers are not local yield trials.
